name: WayriCAD Quick PI
description: Local 2.5D power-integrity simulation with source/sink terminals, copper meshes and native result views.
description_full: Solve DC voltage drop, current density and Joule loss on actual filled traces, pads, zones and plated via barrels. Inspect net geometry, conforming mesh and field results in a native window; export a self-contained HTML report. Includes current/energy checks, explicit stackup and plating inputs, and a pulse-duration temperature-risk screen. KiCad 10 native Python with NumPy, SciPy, VTK and Matplotlib is required. This is a layered DC model, not a full-wave AC or thermal-field solver.
